title: LIFELONG-SOTOPIA: EVALUATING SOCIAL INTELLIGENCE OF LANGUAGE AGENTS OVER LIFELONG SOCIAL INTERACTIONS
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the social intelligence and consistency of language agents in simulated social interactions. While it includes a standard Ethical Statement and mentions Social Rules as a performance metric (adherence to norms and legal rules), it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics as its primary focus.
